pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped dark brown polygons with jagged, serrated edges. The spatial area of individual patches is significantly greater than the separating corridors. Edge gradients are sharp at the pixel level between the dark and light regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively thin and uniform throughout the visible flank and lower neck regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane is visible as a dark, short, upright fringe along the dorsal line of the neck. The silhouette exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude jaggedness against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian subject (oxpecker) clinging to the lower right shoulder/chest region of the giraffe.
